description: Fill this template with actual adjacent or interleaved unprofiled model measurements. Empty pairs contain no timing evidence.

contracts.hash_definition: SHA-256 of the same frozen workload, precision, Graph/stream, quality and timing contract; source revisions are recorded separately.

pair_fields.baseline_e2e_ms: Positive finite observed synchronized baseline duration in milliseconds
pair_fields.candidate_e2e_ms: Positive finite observed synchronized candidate duration in milliseconds
pair_fields.valid: Boolean; true only when the frozen contract and measurement conditions hold
pair_fields.profiled: Boolean; false for performance comparison samples
pair_fields.exclusion_reason: Reason for invalid samples, retained alongside their observed data
